extracted.intended_audience: journalists, reporters, and media professionals seeking Habitat for Humanity EMEA/Africa media assets
extracted.subtask_description: Organization webpage describing available media assets and providing regional communications contacts for Europe, Middle East & Africa and Africa. Useful for journalists requesting photos, case studies, research or information for news coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Available media assets
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat can offer detailed information, case studies, and housing research as well as hi-resolution photos to cover regional housing issues or specific problems in Europe, Middle East and Africa.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are the types of materials the organisation can provide to support reporting: detailed information, case studies, housing research, and high-resolution photos.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional media contacts / contact protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: Please contact: Europe and the Middle east: Katarzyna Jasik-Caínzos, Communications Director, Europe and the Middle East (Phone: +32 478 88 79 08; Email: [email protected]). Africa: Caroline Nyamamu, Communications Director, Africa (Phone: +254 759 067 659; Email: [email protected]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed regional communications directors as the primary points of contact when requesting media assets, interviews, case-study details, or regional research. The page presents separate contacts for EMEA and Africa.
